notes: Added missing schema/contract, core logic refinement, and integration hardening stories for FEAT-2.

change_log.value: Add Pydantic schema for specialty identification I/O
Normalize and rank NUCC outputs with confidence scoring
Add caching and deduplication for specialty results
Add error handling and fallback behavior

stories.title: Define Specialty Identification Schema and Contract
stories.description: Create Pydantic models for specialty identification request and response, including fields for user input, expanded queries, NUCC codes, labels, and confidence scores, ensuring compatibility with tool_router validation.

stories.title: Implement Confidence Scoring and Ranking Logic
stories.description: Enhance specialty_service to normalize outputs from regex and vector pipelines, assign confidence scores, deduplicate NUCC codes, and return ranked specialties for downstream consumption.

stories.title: Add Caching and Deduplication Layer for Specialty Results
stories.description: Introduce lightweight caching of specialty identification results based on normalized user input and ensure strict deduplication of NUCC codes across pipelines to reduce repeated computation and improve consistency.

stories.title: Implement Error Handling and Fallback Strategy
stories.description: Add robust error handling for specialty identification failures, including fallback to taxonomy-only mapping, safe empty responses, and logging via debug_logger for traceability.
